s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of headache and vision loss with sinus inflammation
salient_findings: Severe headache with worsening over time
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
No history of chronic or allergic rhinosinusitis
Recent diagnosis of COVID-19
Rhinorrhea three weeks prior to presentation
Headache for 2 weeks
Vision loss in the right eye for 2 days
Severe pain on ocular motion
Right eye visual acuity limited to hand-motion detection
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation on CT
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone with extension of inflammation into the apex
Positive sinus cultures for Streptococcus constellatus
Elevated Serum IgG4 levels

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of headache and vision loss with sinus inflammation
salient_findings: Severe headache with worsening over time
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
No history of chronic or allergic rhinosinusitis
Recent diagnosis of COVID-19
Rhinorrhea three weeks prior to presentation
Headache for 2 weeks
Vision loss in the right eye for 2 days
Severe pain on ocular motion
Right eye visual acuity limited to hand-motion detection
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation on CT

Elevated Serum IgG4 levels

shortlist.label: IgG4-related disease
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated Serum IgG4 levels and dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells

shortlist.label: Orbital Apex Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone with extension of inflammation into the apex and vision loss

shortlist.label: Acute Bacterial Sinusitis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive sinus cultures for Streptococcus constellatus and opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation

shortlist.label: Invasive Aspergillosis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent diagnosis of COVID-19 and severe pain on ocular motion

shortlist.label: Rhino-orbital Mucormycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Vision loss and severe pain on ocular motion with sinus inflammation

raw.rationale: Patient's symptoms of vision loss, severe pain on ocular motion, and bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone with extension of inflammation into the apex are consistent with Orbital Apex Syndrome, a condition that can be caused by invasive fungal infections like Invasive Aspergillosis, but also by other conditions such as bacterial sinusitis or IgG4-related disease.

rejected.label: Invasive Aspergillosis
rejected.why: While possible, the presence of Streptococcus constellatus in sinus cultures and the clinical presentation more strongly suggest a bacterial or inflammatory cause rather than a fungal one.

rejected.label: IgG4-related disease
rejected.why: Although the patient has elevated IgG4 levels and a dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells, the acute presentation and presence of bacterial infection suggest a more immediate infectious cause.

rejected.label: Acute Bacterial Sinusitis
rejected.why: While the patient has positive sinus cultures for Streptococcus constellatus, the severity of the symptoms, including vision loss and bony erosion, suggest a more complex condition than simple sinusitis.

rejected.label: Rhino-orbital Mucormycosis
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of mucormycosis in the provided information, and the clinical presentation and lab findings do not strongly support this diagnosis.
